theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl (m + 1) → Eucl P) (Ω : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (h : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ) (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (W : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen Ω → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → (∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzOnWith K Φ Ω) → (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → ContDiff ℝ 1 h → MeasurableSet W → W ⊆ Φ '' Ω → (∀ w ∈ Ω, Φ w ∈ W → f (Φ w) = h w ∧ fderiv ℝ h w = 0) → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) (W ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) = 0
